## What this document is

Analysis 17 explored a rule that lowers a cytokine's gate for cells positive
for another cytokine where the two are co-expressed beyond independence (the
"coexpression gates"; `scripts/r/coexpression-gates.R`, also available in
StimGate as `stimControl(cytPosMethod = "coexpression")`). Here the rule is
applied to every ACS population, stimulation and donor, starting from Analysis
9's ordinary gates, to see what it does at scale and to catch anything
pathological.

All six cytokines Analysis 9b gates (IFNg, IL2, TNF, IL17, IL6 and IL22) are
considered jointly: every ordered pair of them is tried in every tube, and
every tube is described by the same 64 combinations. A cytokine without a gate
in a tube is negative there.

For each stimulated tube and every ordered pair of cytokines (a, b), b's gate
is lowered for cells above a's gate when:

1. (screened version only) the cells above both ordinary gates show a clear
   net response (z > 2);
2. working back from a floor (the control tube's main negative peak, from
   non-zero values, plus 1.5 robust SDs) in 20 bins, the bins from the ordinary
   gate down to the new gate depart from independence (Pearson residual ≥ 3.5,
   expected count from the stimulated tube's own marginal shares) and are
   pure: purity (1 − control share / stimulated share) is positive and at
   least 0.75 times the double positives' purity (taken as zero when that is
   not positive), both for the lowest bin on its own and for all the bins
   together;
3. the added band is trimmed along a: a's cut rises (in 20ths of a's
   gate-to-floor distance) until the slice above it, and the band above that,
   are pure enough.

A cell is b-positive if above b's ordinary gate, or above the raised a cut and
the lowered b gate for any a. Control tubes are classified with their
stimulated tube's gates.

Each tube is scored under three rules:

- **ordinary**: Analysis 9b's ordinary gates (the baseline);
- **coexpression (screened)**: the rule above with step 1, so only pairs
  whose double positives already show a clear response are tried;
- **coexpression (unscreened)**: the rule without step 1, so every pair is
  tried whatever the double positives show, and only the independence and
  purity checks decide.

For each population this document shows:

- background-subtracted frequencies (stimulated minus control) of
  single-positive cells (exactly one cytokine) and multi-positive cells (two or
  more), ordinary gates against each coexpression version, one point per
  donor;
- for each cytokine, how its single-positive frequency (positive for it alone)
  and multi-positive frequency (positive for it and another) change;
- a table of possible pathologies per tube (below);
- hexagon plots of the tubes whose multi-positive frequency changed most under
  each version, for the pair of cytokines that added the most cells;
- response tests for every combination under each rule (below);
- COMPASS functionality and polyfunctionality scores fitted separately on the
  combination counts of each rule.

Possible pathologies flagged per tube and version:

- **bottom bin**: a gate lowered into the bin next to its floor, so the floor,
  not the data, stopped it;
- **control**: control cells called multi-positive at least doubled and up by
  ten or more;
- **multi jump**: the net multi-positive frequency more than tripled (from at
  least 0.01%);
- **single negative**: the net single-positive frequency driven below −0.05%.

Manual gating is not used here as a measure of accuracy. The ACS manual gates
set one overall threshold per cytokine, so they miss cells that respond only
weakly in one cytokine alongside another and under-count multi-positive
cells; a frequency above the manual one is not an error.

Everything is read from Analysis 9b's most recent run; Analysis 9b's caches are
never changed. Results are cached under the projr cache folder
`acs_cytof_coexpression/`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)

root_dir <- normalizePath(if (file.exists("DESCRIPTION")) "." else "..", winslash = "/")
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(root_dir, "DESCRIPTION")))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root_dir)

scripts_r_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "scripts", "r")
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "analysis-runtime.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "analysis-plot-style.R"))
fig_key <- .analysis_mode_key("18-explore-acs-cytof-coexpression-gates", sized = FALSE)
for (fn in c(
  "acs_cytof-helper.R", "acs_cytof-gate.R", "acs_cytof-methods.R",
  "acs_cytof-debug.R", "acs_cytof-explore-cytpos.R", "coexpression-gates.R",
  "acs_cytof-coexpression-gates.R"
)) {
  source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, fn))
}
run_simulations <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env("run_simulations", "RUN_SIMULATIONS", FALSE))
run_plots <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env("run_plots", "RUN_PLOTS", TRUE))
run_compass <- .get_qmd_param_env("run_compass", "RUN_COMPASS", NULL)
run_compass <- if (is.null(run_compass)) run_simulations else .as_flag(run_compass)
n_workers <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("ACS_COEX_WORKERS", "1"))
compass_iterations <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("ACS_COEX_COMPASS_ITERATIONS", "10000"))
```

```{r}
#| label: settings
#| include: false
pop_vec <- c("tcrgd", "cd4", "cd8", "nk", "nk_pre", "b")
# Every cytokine Analysis 9b gates, considered jointly.
channel_map <- .acsCytofChannelMap()
rule_settings <- .acsCoexGatesSettings()
rule_vec <- .acsCoexGatesRules()
alpha <- 0.05
run_settings <- list(
  semantics = .acsCoexGatesSemantics, rule = rule_settings, rules = rule_vec,
  markers = unname(channel_map), pops = pop_vec
)
compass_settings <- c(run_settings, list(iterations = compass_iterations, replications = 8L, seed = 100L))
```

```{r}
#| label: paths
#| include: false
# Analysis 9b's caches are only read: never create or change them here.
path_gs_base <- projr::projr_path_get("cache", "acs_cytof", "gs", create = FALSE, format = "absolute")
path_scratch_base <- projr::projr_path_get("cache", "acs_cytof", "scratch", create = FALSE, format = "absolute")
cache_dir <- projr::projr_path_get_dir(
  "cache", "acs_cytof_coexpression", create = run_simulations || run_compass, format = "absolute"
)
path_pop <- function(pop) file.path(cache_dir, paste0(pop, ".rds"))
path_compass <- file.path(cache_dir, "compass.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: run
#| include: false
# One population at a time; each is written atomically once complete.
if (isTRUE(run_simulations)) {
  for (pop in pop_vec) {
    message("Coexpression gates (screened and unscreened): ", pop)
    paths <- .acsCytofPopulationPaths(pop, "unused", path_gs_base, path_scratch_base)
    res <- .acsCoexGatesPopulation(pop, paths, channel_map, rule_settings, workers = n_workers)
    .write_rds_atomic(list(settings = run_settings, result = res), path_pop(pop))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: collate
#| include: false
read_pop <- function(pop) {
  if (!file.exists(path_pop(pop))) {
    stop("No co-expression gate results for population '", pop, "' at ", path_pop(pop),
      ". Render with RUN_SIMULATIONS=true first.")
  }
  x <- readRDS(path_pop(pop))
  if (!identical(x$settings, run_settings)) {
    stop("Cached co-expression gate results for '", pop, "' were made with other settings.")
  }
  x$result
}
res_all <- lapply(stats::setNames(pop_vec, pop_vec), read_pop)
low_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res_all, `[[`, "low"))
counts_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res_all, `[[`, "counts"))
freq_all <- .acsCoexGatesFreq(counts_all)
paired_all <- .acsCoexGatesPaired(.acsCoexGatesSingleMulti(freq_all))
flags_all <- .acsCoexGatesFlags(low_all, paired_all, rule_settings)
# Response tests for every combination and marginal, per rule.
test_counts_all <- .acsCoexGatesTestCounts(counts_all)
tests_all <- .acsCoexGatesResponseTests(test_counts_all, alpha = alpha)
compare_all <- .acsCoexGatesResponseCompare(tests_all)
response_summary_all <- .acsCoexGatesResponseSummary(tests_all, compare_all)
contamination_all <- .acsCoexGatesContamination(test_counts_all)
```

```{r}
#| label: compass
#| include: false
if (isTRUE(run_compass)) {
  # One fit per population, stimulation and rule, forked over the workers.
  # Every rule uses the same categories (`.acsCoexGatesCompassKeep()`).
  fit_jobs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pop_vec, function(pop) {
    stims <- sort(unique(counts_all$stim[counts_all$pop == pop]))
    expand.grid(pop = pop, stim = stims, rule = rule_vec, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  fit_one <- function(i) {
    job <- fit_jobs[i, ]
    counts_curr <- counts_all[counts_all$pop == job$pop & counts_all$stim == job$stim, ]
    fit <- .acsCoexGatesCompass(counts_curr, job$rule, keep = .acsCoexGatesCompassKeep(counts_curr),
      iterations = compass_settings$iterations, replications = compass_settings$replications,
      seed = compass_settings$seed)
    fit$scores$pop <- job$pop
    fit$scores$stim <- job$stim
    fit$subsets$pop <- job$pop
    fit$subsets$stim <- job$stim
    fit
  }
  fits <- if (n_workers > 1L) {
    oplan <- future::plan(future::multicore, workers = n_workers)
    fits_out <- future.apply::future_lapply(seq_len(nrow(fit_jobs)), fit_one, future.seed = TRUE)
    future::plan(oplan)
    fits_out
  } else {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(fit_jobs)), fit_one)
  }
  .write_rds_atomic(list(
    settings = compass_settings,
    scores = do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, `[[`, "scores")),
    subsets = do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, `[[`, "subsets"))
  ), path_compass)
}
compass <- if (file.exists(path_compass)) readRDS(path_compass)
if (!is.null(compass) && !identical(compass$settings, compass_settings)) compass <- NULL
```

## Overview

```{r}
#| label: overview
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  cat("Per population and coexpression version: tubes (stimulated tubes with a control tube),",
    "median net single- and multi-positive frequencies (%) with the ordinary gates and with",
    "that version, the number of ordered pairs lowered per tube (median) and tubes with each",
    "flag.\n\n")
  any_tbl <- paired_all[paired_all$cytokine == "any", ]
  overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pop_vec, function(pop) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(setdiff(rule_vec, "ordinary"), function(rule) {
      s <- any_tbl[any_tbl$pop == pop & any_tbl$rule == rule & any_tbl$type == "single", ]
      m <- any_tbl[any_tbl$pop == pop & any_tbl$rule == rule & any_tbl$type == "multi", ]
      f <- flags_all[flags_all$pop == pop & flags_all$rule == rule, ]
      data.frame(pop = pop, version = rule, tubes = nrow(f),
        singleOrd = round(100 * stats::median(s$propBsOrdinary), 3),
        singleCoex = round(100 * stats::median(s$propBsCoexpr), 3),
        multiOrd = round(100 * stats::median(m$propBsOrdinary), 3),
        multiCoex = round(100 * stats::median(m$propBsCoexpr), 3),
        pairsLowered = stats::median(f$nLowered),
        bottomBin = sum(f$flagBottomBin), control = sum(f$flagControl),
        multiJump = sum(f$flagMultiJump), singleNegative = sum(f$flagSingleNegative))
    }))
  }))
  print(knitr::kable(overview, row.names = FALSE))
  .analysis_report_table(flags_all, c(fig_key, "tube-flags.csv"),
    "Per tube and coexpression version: pairs lowered, cells added and pathology flags.", root_dir)
  .analysis_report_table(low_all, c(fig_key, "lowered-gates.csv"),
    "Per tube, coexpression version and ordered cytokine pair: ordinary, lowered and raised gates, floors, z and purity.",
    root_dir, quiet = TRUE)
  .analysis_report_table(counts_all, c(fig_key, "combination-counts.csv"),
    "Per tube, rule and tube type: cell counts of every combination of the six cytokines.",
    root_dir, quiet = TRUE)
  .analysis_report_table(paired_all, c(fig_key, "single-multi-frequencies.csv"),
    "Per tube: single- and multi-positive background-subtracted frequencies, ordinary gates and each coexpression version.",
    root_dir, quiet = TRUE)
}
```

## Response tests

For each rule, population, stimulation and combination (every exclusive
combination of the six cytokines with at least one positive, and each
cytokine on its own whatever the others, "(any)"), two questions:

- **per donor**: does the stimulated tube have a larger share of cells in the
  combination than the control tube? One-sided Fisher's exact test at
  `r alpha`, not adjusted; reported as the number of donors with a
  significant response.
- **across donors**: is the stimulated frequency larger than the control
  frequency? One-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test of stimulated minus
  control frequency (a paired t-test as a secondary check), with the
  Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across all combinations within each
  population, stimulation and rule. A combination is called responding when
  its adjusted Wilcoxon p-value is below `r alpha`. Combinations where every
  donor's difference is zero cannot be tested and are left out of the
  adjustment.

```{r}
#| label: response-summary
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  cat("Combinations called responding (adjusted Wilcoxon), summed over stimulations, per",
    "population and rule; in brackets those called responding by that rule only.\n\n")
  rs <- stats::aggregate(cbind(nTested, nResponding, nOnlyThisRule) ~ pop + rule + type,
    response_summary_all, sum)
  rs$value <- paste0(rs$nResponding, " (", rs$nOnlyThisRule, ")")
  rs_wide <- stats::reshape(rs[c("pop", "type", "rule", "value")], idvar = c("pop", "type"),
    timevar = "rule", direction = "wide")
  names(rs_wide) <- sub("^value[.]", "", names(rs_wide))
  rs_wide <- rs_wide[order(match(rs_wide$pop, pop_vec), rs_wide$type), c("pop", "type", rule_vec)]
  print(knitr::kable(rs_wide, row.names = FALSE))
  .analysis_report_table(response_summary_all, c(fig_key, "response-summary.csv"),
    "Per population, stimulation, rule and type of combination: combinations tested, called responding (Wilcoxon and t-test) and called responding by that rule only.",
    root_dir)
  .analysis_report_table(tests_all, c(fig_key, "response-tests.csv"),
    "Per population, stimulation, rule and combination: donors with a significant Fisher's test, frequencies, and raw and adjusted Wilcoxon and t-test p-values.",
    root_dir, quiet = TRUE)
  .analysis_report_table(test_counts_all, c(fig_key, "response-test-counts.csv"),
    "Per donor, rule and combination: stimulated and control counts and frequencies tested.",
    root_dir, quiet = TRUE)

  changed <- compare_all[compare_all$changed, ]
  .analysis_report_table(changed, c(fig_key, "response-changed.csv"),
    "Combinations whose response call differs between the rules.", root_dir)
  only_unscreened <- compare_all[compare_all$unscreenedOnly, ]
  cat("\n\n", nrow(only_unscreened), " population, stimulation and combination sets are called",
    " responding by the unscreened rule only.", sep = "")
  if (nrow(only_unscreened)) {
    shown <- only_unscreened[c("pop", "stim", "type", "combn", "pWilcoxAdj_ordinary",
      "pWilcoxAdj_screened", "pWilcoxAdj_unscreened", "nDonorFisher_unscreened")]
    shown$combn <- .acsCoexGatesCombnLabel(shown$combn, shown$type)
    shown[grep("^pWilcox", names(shown))] <- lapply(shown[grep("^pWilcox", names(shown))], signif, 2)
    if (nrow(shown) <= 15L) {
      cat("\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(shown, row.names = FALSE))
    }
    .analysis_report_table(only_unscreened, c(fig_key, "response-unscreened-only.csv"),
      "Combinations called responding by the unscreened rule only.", root_dir)
  }
}
```

### Control-tube cells added

The lowered gates are applied to the control tube with the stimulated tube's
gates. Cells they add there are background: the table gives the
cytokine-positive calls each version adds over the ordinary gates (summed over
cytokines) per million cells in each tube, summed over donors and
stimulations, and the control rate as a share of the stimulated rate (roughly
the share of the added calls the background accounts for).

```{r}
#| label: contamination
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  ct <- stats::aggregate(cbind(cellsStim, cellsUns, addedStim, addedUns) ~ pop + rule,
    contamination_all, sum)
  ct$stimPerMillion <- round(1e6 * ct$addedStim / ct$cellsStim, 1)
  ct$controlPerMillion <- round(1e6 * ct$addedUns / ct$cellsUns, 1)
  ct$controlShare <- round(ifelse(ct$addedStim > 0,
    (ct$addedUns / ct$cellsUns) / (ct$addedStim / ct$cellsStim), NA_real_), 3)
  ct <- ct[order(match(ct$pop, pop_vec), ct$rule),
    c("pop", "rule", "addedStim", "addedUns", "stimPerMillion", "controlPerMillion", "controlShare")]
  print(knitr::kable(ct, row.names = FALSE))
  .analysis_report_table(contamination_all, c(fig_key, "control-added.csv"),
    "Per population, stimulation and coexpression version: cytokine-positive calls added over the ordinary gates in each tube.",
    root_dir)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: populations
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  for (pop in pop_vec) {
    fig_dir <- .analysis_fig_dir(c(fig_key, pop), root_dir)
    pop_paired <- paired_all[paired_all$pop == pop, ]
    cat("\n\n## ", pop, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n\n### Single- and multi-positive frequencies\n\n")
    cat("Blue: coexpression (screened); light blue: coexpression (unscreened).\n\n")
    .analysis_print_save_fig(.acsCoexGatesScatterPlot(pop_paired),
      file.path(fig_dir, "single-multi-scatter.png"), width = 30, height = 16)
    cat("\n\n### Change for each cytokine\n\n")
    .analysis_print_save_fig(.acsCoexGatesDiffPlot(pop_paired),
      file.path(fig_dir, "cytokine-change.png"), width = 30, height = 24)

    cat("\n\n### Response tests\n\n")
    cat("-log10 of the adjusted Wilcoxon p-value for each combination called responding",
      "by any rule in any stimulation, and for each cytokine on its own ((any)); dots mark",
      "combinations called responding, grey ones could not be tested.\n\n")
    pop_tests <- tests_all[tests_all$pop == pop, ]
    hm <- .acsCoexGatesResponseHeatmap(pop_tests)
    hm_n_rows <- length(levels(hm$data$label))
    .analysis_print_save_fig(hm, file.path(fig_dir, "response-heatmap.png"),
      width = 30, height = 8 + 0.5 * hm_n_rows, allow_tall = TRUE)

    paths <- .acsCytofPopulationPaths(pop, "unused", path_gs_base, path_scratch_base)
    gs <- NULL
    for (rule in setdiff(rule_vec, "ordinary")) {
      cat("\n\n### Tubes that changed most: ", .acsCoexGatesRuleLabels[[rule]], "\n\n", sep = "")
      cat("The eight tubes with the largest change in net multi-positive frequency under this",
        "version; for each, the lowered pair that added the most stimulated cells (x: the",
        "cytokine the cells are positive for; y: the cytokine whose gate is lowered).\n\n")
      f <- flags_all[flags_all$pop == pop & flags_all$rule == rule, ]
      f <- f[order(-abs(f$multiBsCoexpr - f$multiBsOrdinary)), ]
      f <- utils::head(f[f$nLowered > 0, ], 8L)
      if (!nrow(f)) {
        cat("No gate was lowered.\n\n")
        next
      }
      if (is.null(gs)) {
        gs <- flowWorkspace::load_gs(paths$gs, backend_readonly = TRUE)
        sample_map <- .acsCytofReadPreprocessing(paths$gs, gs)$sampleMap
        gates <- stimgate::getStimGates(paths$stimgate)
      }
      tubes <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(f)), function(i) {
        lw <- low_all[low_all$pop == pop & low_all$rule == rule & low_all$stim == f$stim[[i]] &
          low_all$donor == f$donor[[i]] & low_all$lowered, ]
        lw <- lw[which.max(lw$addedStim), ]
        list(
          dat = .acsCytposTubeData(gs, sample_map, gates, f$donor[[i]], f$stim[[i]], channel_map),
          a = lw$a, b = lw$b, cut = lw$cut, condCut = lw$condCut,
          label = paste0(f$donor[[i]], " ", f$stim[[i]], ": ", lw$b, " among ", lw$a, "+")
        )
      })
      .analysis_print_save_fig(.acsCoexGatesTubeHexPlot(tubes, rule),
        file.path(fig_dir, paste0("most-changed-hex-", rule, ".png")), width = 30, height = 34)
    }
  }
}
```

## COMPASS

COMPASS (`SimpleCOMPASS`, `r compass_iterations` iterations, 8 replications,
seed 100) is fitted separately for each population, stimulation and rule on
that rule's combination counts. Every fit uses the same categories: the
all-negative one and those with at least 5 stimulated cells in at least 3
donors under any rule (the rare ones carry no information and slow the
sampler). Each point is a donor's score with the ordinary gates (x) and with
a coexpression version (y; blue screened, light blue unscreened).

```{r}
#| label: compass-plots
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 12
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  if (is.null(compass)) {
    cat("No COMPASS results for these settings; render with RUN_COMPASS=true.\n\n")
  } else {
    fig_dir <- .analysis_fig_dir(c(fig_key, "compass"), root_dir)
    cat("\n\n### Functionality score\n\n")
    .analysis_print_save_fig(.acsCoexGatesCompassPlot(compass$scores, "fs"),
      file.path(fig_dir, "functionality.png"), width = 36, height = 30)
    cat("\n\n### Polyfunctionality score\n\n")
    .analysis_print_save_fig(.acsCoexGatesCompassPlot(compass$scores, "pfs"),
      file.path(fig_dir, "polyfunctionality.png"), width = 36, height = 30)
    .analysis_report_table(compass$scores, c(fig_key, "compass-scores.csv"),
      "COMPASS functionality and polyfunctionality scores per donor and rule.",
      root_dir)
    .analysis_report_table(compass$subsets, c(fig_key, "compass-subsets.csv"),
      "COMPASS mean posterior response probability per subset and rule.",
      root_dir)
  }
}
```

```{r}
```
